scope: versioned browser workbenches that persist accepted parameters, user presets, camera, material or renderer state

observedFailure.effect: a newer candidate can overwrite the prior accepted-version client state
observedFailure.recoveryLimit: post-failure backup preserves the currently stored bytes but cannot reconstruct pre-overwrite bytes

assertions: a candidate version must not write to an accepted baseline storage key
the payload version must match the namespace version unless an explicit one-shot migration contract is active
migration must copy before write and preserve the exact source bytes under an immutable recovery key
a post-overwrite backup does not prove recovery of the pre-overwrite state
rollback must reopen the accepted baseline without consuming candidate state
passing rendering or interaction tests cannot promote a build whose storage isolation gate fails
public delivery evidence must bind the exact current page blob after any rollback or canonical-entry change
nextValidation: Learning Flywheel should implement a four-fixture replay: isolated namespace pass; same-key cross-version hold; verified copy-before-write migration pass; post-overwrite backup remains unknown.
